qc.label_under_test: The frequency adverb 'often' (including 'more often than not' and pre-nominal 'often overlooked'); weaker on synonyms, quiet on other frequency words such as rarely, sometimes, seldom, never.

neighbours.label: The word family for 'frequent': 'often', 'common'/'Common', 'frequent(ly)' and their translations (souvent, häufig, よく); quiet on other frequency ideas (rarely, many, every day, prone to).
fire: She often walks to the library after lunch.
Colds are common in winter, especially among young children.
He is a frequent visitor to the old harbor café.
Trains to the coast run frequently on weekends.
Il pleut souvent en Bretagne au printemps.
私はよくこの公園で本を読みます。
Common mistakes include forgetting to save your work.
quiet: She rarely walks to the library after lunch.
Colds spread among young children in winter.
He visits the old harbor café every day.
Trains to the coast run on weekends.
Il pleut parfois en Bretagne au printemps.
私は時々この公園で本を読みます。
Many mistakes involve forgetting to save your work.

predictions: Expect 7-8/8 fire (common and the Japanese may be weaker), near misses under 0.2; rarely/parfois/selten could leak a little.
